result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the restaurant name under Popular right now is cut off mid-character.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' displays as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final 'n' clipped off, likely colliding with the rating element on the same line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the title-rating row layout to reserve space for the rating, using flex with overflow ellipsis or wrapping so the full name is readable and not cut mid-character.
